verdict.rationale: Dialpad publishes a public developer platform with OAuth token generation, an official Python client library, and documented rate limits. Its API reference covers actionable operations: adding call participants, assigning operators to queued calls, blocking numbers, creating access policies, and removing recordings. Probes confirmed the developer docs and llms.txt are live. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: With powerful APIs, unlock the amazing capabilities of the Dialpad platform to build feature rich applications.
Dialpad also provides a python client library, making it easier than ever to use the APIs in your python applications.
Adds another participant to a call. Valid methods to add are by phone or by target.
Creates a new custom access control policy. Requires a company admin API key.
The current rate limits are 20 requests/second per company.
